entries.description: I build Python tools that turn telescope observations into science-ready data. My work at Skynet spans automated optical image processing, time-series photometry, and stellar-cluster analysis.
highlights: Developing an optical data-processing pipeline that automates the processing of robotic telescope observations.
Implemented and tested workflows for astrometric solving, photometric calibration, source detection, image rendering, and analysis using FITS data and telescope metadata.
Developing astronomical data tools that combine automated processing, visualization, and scientific analysis.
Supported by an $8,000 NASA-funded North Carolina Space Grant Undergraduate Scholarship, awarded in June 2026; presented the research project at two conferences.

entries.description: I used radio telescope observations to study pulsars and the rotation of Andromeda, then helped students investigate the structure of our own galaxy. The work combined observing, research instruction, and telescope instrumentation.
highlights: Conducted research using Green Bank Observatory’s 20-meter and 40-foot telescopes.
Instructed students through a Galactic-structure research project using Milky Way radio observations.
Designed a 3D-printed enclosure for a radio telescope’s voltage test system in Autodesk Fusion.

entries.description: I worked on mission planning and technology proposals through NASA’s L’SPACE Program. As a project manager and scientist, I led a lunar rover mission concept and contributed to a proposal for astronaut health-monitoring technology.
highlights: Led an interdisciplinary team developing a NASA Discovery-class lunar rover mission concept, coordinating science goals, instruments, rover design, and budgeting.
Coordinated mission concept, system requirements, mission definition, and preliminary design review documentation; the final preliminary design review exceeded 220 pages.
Collaborated on a 12-person team developing a technical proposal for a novel astronaut health-monitoring technology.
Served as a secondary proposal reviewer, scoring submissions against a solicitation rubric and providing feedback to teams.

entries.description: At Goshen Engineering, I work on manufacturing processes, mechanical design, and automation projects. I also support the company’s implementation of an ISO 9001 quality management system.
highlights: Developing controlled documentation for design, manufacturing, administrative, and quality processes.
Improved steel part production by researching thermal properties and calculating powder-coat oven temperatures and bake-time ranges.
Designed a custom stack-rack system in Autodesk Fusion to improve part organization, storage capacity, and material handling.
Collaborated with automation engineers on a robot cell for a CNC ironworker and an automated machining system, evaluating end effectors and components with vendors.

entries.description: I lead news coverage at NASASpaceflight, working with writers and editors to report on astrophysics and spaceflight. Alongside writing and editing, I interview scientists and mission teams and provide live launch commentary.
highlights: Managing a team of more than 20 writers and editors, coordinating editorial planning, regular meetings, and team membership.
Authored more than 100 articles and edited and oversaw publication of multiple articles per week.
Provided on-site launch coverage in Florida, including interviews with mission teams, press conferences, and live commentary.
Hosted major launch broadcasts, including the James Webb Space Telescope and Artemis I, each exceeding 1.3 million views.
